_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 15 — arm 12 (single-layer canonical) + CARD LV-1, the bias-free
per-LOS iono seeding (docs/SPEC_level_information_budget.md).  Single knob:
network.iono_seed_field_frame.  Carry stays ON (this is the carry-ON leg).
WHAT LV-1 DOES.  StateInitializer::computeIonosphereSeed returns the geometry-free
code combination raw = I_los + (d_r1-d_r2)/(a1-a2): `mod` removes the satellite side
and the geometry but NOT the receiver DCB, so every seed of a station carries that
station's own GF hardware bias (measured DOY-129: mean -15 slant-TECU, continent-
clustered, std 21).  LV-1 replaces the station-common content with the field's own
value at each LOS's IPP:  seed' = raw - median_r(raw) + m(el)*VTEC_SH(IPP), field
taken lag-1 (a00 climatology prior = 32.24 TECU before the first solve).
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN — and it is NOT the SPEC's original one.  The spec
attributes the a00 collapse to ~0.04 info x ~376 LOS of per-LOS stiffness toward the
bias-in seed frame.  THAT CHANNEL DOES NOT EXIST ON THIS PATH.  The per-station
StateManager vector is a frozen LINEARIZATION POINT (written once at setup, never
written back), the per-epoch absolute network solve carries NO Kalman prior on the
local nuisances, and every row touching a GPS iono column forms its RHS against x_lin
with that row's own A_r coefficient (data rows via em.innovations; the SH tie via
innov = -x(iono_idx)).  So a seed shift delta gives y -> y - A_r e_c delta and the
reduced RHS b_red = u_s - N_sr N_rr^-1 u_r is EXACTLY invariant (proven 2026-08-01,
memory project_network_xlin_invariance).  Therefore:
- a00 trajectory: UNCHANGED to within trace noise vs arm 12 (ignition ~24.7, trough
~6-7, inflection up by ~ep 16, gate 0/0/0, in-band 20/20).  A material a00 change
here would FALSIFY the invariance theorem and is the more interesting outcome.
- What SHOULD move, because they read PREFIT quantities in the x_lin frame:
(a) the receiver-DCB linearization point.  initializeCodeBiases subtracts
(alpha_b - alpha_1)*x(iono) when it seeds the DCB, so with a bias-IN iono seed
the receiver's GF lump is booked into the ionosphere and x_lin(DCB) is left
near zero; with LV-1 it lands near the true bias.  The rx-CB carry's inject
gate tests |value_abs - x_lin(cb)| against 10 sigma + 0.5 m -- a PREFIT,
frame-dependent screen -- so PREDICT the innovation-skip rate FALLS well below
arm 13's 58 % and the fold count rises.
(b) network_prefit_census.csv statistics (trace-only, no solve effect).
- Run-end LV-1 line: non-zero `reframed`, ~61 station-epoch offsets at cold start,
and the per-station offset log lines should agree in sign and scale with
scripts/extcb_gim_verdict.py's bias_TECU column (Europe ~ -20..-25, KRGG/OAFA/GAMB
+40..+47).  That agreement is the free cross-validation this arm is really for.
20 epochs is inside ignition: gate wiring + counters + offsets read only.
